contexts: teaching hospital women's health physiotherapy service
reading: Attendance depends on factors visible in records (age, distance, interpreter need; claims c1 and c4) and on barriers that only women can report (childcare, embarrassment, timing; claim c2). No study has joined the two (claim c5), and surveys lose exactly the women who do not attend. Class timing looks modifiable (claim c3). The service's question is therefore cross-sectional: which factors, reported and recorded, go with attendance among all women referred in one year.

nodes.label: Attendance at four or more sessions

nodes.detail: Followed by higher attendance in one service (c3).

summary: Map joins recorded factors and reported barriers to attendance and shows the missing link between them.
